findings.title: Windows AR .cmd scripts expand unsanitized location via unquoted %4, yielding LocalSystem RCE.
findings.description: WinExecdRun passes time/ruleid/location/filename as one CreateProcess argument after user/ip. Stock netsh.cmd and restart-ossec.cmd log with ECHO %0 %1 ... %9 unquoted before validating the action. cmd.exe re-parses & | < > after percent expansion. analysisd CRAFTED_* gates only user and srcip; agents control the location suffix after ->. Unlike the already-flagged CreateProcess quote-break, this needs no double-quote in the payload and survives fixes that only correct CreateProcess quoting.
findings.impact: Command execution as LocalSystem on Windows agents with active response enabled whenever a forwarded AR embeds a crafted event location (including location=all fan-out from a malicious registered agent).
findings.attack_path:
1. Enable AR on Windows agents and configure a manager AR that targets them (all/specific/remote).
2. Attacker with a registered agent key emits an event whose location suffix contains cmd metacharacters, e.g. x&calc&y.
3. analysisd fires AR; remoted forwards execd message with raw location inside tmp_msg.
4. WinExecdRun runs netsh.cmd/restart-ossec.cmd; line 9 expands %4 unquoted; &calc& executes as LocalSystem.
findings.remediation: Quote all %n expansions in Windows AR scripts; strip or allowlist location before OS_Exec; omit location from scripts that only need action/user/ip; keep Windows AR disabled unless required.
findings.poc_video_notes: No Windows agent or cmd.exe harness in this Linux scan environment. Confirmed by tracing unsanitized lf->location into tmp_msg/%4 and cmd.exe percent-expansion-then-reparse semantics for &.
